name: Request / response
summary: The agent only runs when a user sends a message or calls an API, and it stops when it has replied. Nothing happens between requests. This is how most chat assistants and coding agents work by default.
how: User sends a message or request
Agent runs its loop: model calls, tool calls, reply
Agent returns a response and goes idle
Nothing runs until the next request
facts: Predictable and cheap, but never takes initiative
goodFor: Keeping cost and side effects predictable
watchOut: Cannot follow up, monitor or remind on its own
